label: input q at step 2-3 after particular prefixes (first token r/h/j/k/d/0, previous token d/y/a/0/w/i/u)
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit. Fires only in the original phase, essentially only when the input is q (386/387 dev activations) at original position 2 or 3 (100% of mass). It never fires at t=0,1 or t>=4, on <DEL>, or in the copy phase. q at t=2/3 is a necessary condition but not sufficient (precision 6%): whether it crosses threshold depends on the preceding prefix. It fires most often when the first token is r/h/j/k/d/0 and the previous token is d/y/a/0/w/i/u. The strongest activations are prefixes ending in d right before q (e.g. h k d q, j d q, r r d q). Conjoining both prefix sets gives dev P=0.67, R=0.52; either set alone keeps about 99% of mass but drops precision to 15%. The prefix dependence looks like a graded additive threshold rather than a crisp rule.
